title: Make The String Great
summary: Given a string s consisting of lowercase and uppercase English letters, remove adjacent characters that are the same letter but differ in case until no such pairs remain.
statement: Given a string s consisting of lowercase and uppercase English letters, remove adjacent characters that are the same letter but differ in case until no such pairs remain. Return the resulting string, which is guaranteed to be unique under the given constraints. An empty string is considered good.
constraints: Adjacent characters form a bad pair when they are the same letter in opposite cases.
Repeatedly remove bad pairs and return the unique remaining string.
hints: Maintain the already-good prefix in a stack.
If the next character forms an opposite-case pair with the stack top, pop it; otherwise push.
A removal can expose only the new top to the next character, which the stack handles immediately.
This simulates all forced adjacent cancellations and yields the unique stable result.
editorial: This simulates all forced adjacent cancellations and yields the unique stable result.

tests.explanation: Removing E and e exposes no further bad pair, yielding leetcode.
Removing bB then aA then cC leaves the empty string.
